about: the adaptive extractor (extract_adaptive_vm.py) run on the 718 P1-6 folders under the both-Relace per-actor pin reproduces sessions.jsonl.xz's valid/run set exactly, and adds writes_by_task and tactics. On P1-6 (no tactic declared) every per-turn tactic is 'undeclared', question-task writes are 0, and the 102 responder writes all name PAIR-A tasks.
